image_description: A Nile crocodile is partially submerged in murky, yellowish-green water. The head and upper back are visible above the surface, positioned near a bank with overhanging green vegetation on the left. The crocodile's skin texture appears rough and armored. There is faint, illegible text in the bottom right corner.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout tapers to a distinct point, consistent with the V-shape of a crocodile rather than the U-shape of an alligator.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is fully closed and the jawline is flush with the water or obscured by angle; individual teeth are not clearly distinguishable.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is clearly visible on the top of the head. While pupil shape is hard to resolve at this resolution, the dorsal positioning is correct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Two distinct nostril bumps are visible at the very end of the snout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the body shows a long, continuous structure with heavy texturing indicative of armor.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal surface exhibits a rough, pebbled texture consistent with osteoderms, though specific row alignment is slightly blurred by image quality.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Coloration matches the description (grey/brown) and texture is visibly rough.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The belly/ventral side is completely submerged and not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All limbs are submerged and not visible in the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail extends out of the frame to the right; its full length and compression cannot be verified.

artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a string of characters 'RB.BW...' which appears to be a watermark or signature. It is legible but stylistically inconsistent with natural photography, suggesting AI generation or digital overlay artifacts.

The water displacement around the snout lacks realistic ripples or meniscus effects. The boundary between the solid snout and the liquid water is slightly soft and unnatural, lacking the sharp refraction expected in a close-up shot.
The background blur is uniform and painterly, typical of AI depth-of-field simulation rather than optical lens bokeh.
